velocity_integral_fit.method: No-intercept fit of coordinate increments to zero-order-held speed integral, same reliable segment, 80-130ms pairs excluding observed extrema. Dequeue timestamps; not a physical encoder calibration.

post_calibration_position_observation.interpretation_limit: A varying position-related coordinate. Measured position vs target/reference is not established; observed extrema are not universal angle units.

limits: Relative time uses the first complete parsed CAN frame, not the button press.
Physical senders, movement, limit-contact times and units are not inferred.
Zero status-counter increments do not establish perfect capture boundaries.
Packet reconstruction can reject fragments; absence is limited to accepted packets.
A finite offset3 value is a result candidate, not a proven position or travel unit.
